errors.text_span: показва времеви интервал от 15-ти март 2021 г. (15-Mar-21) до 15-ти март 2022 г. (15-Mar-22)
errors.evidence: The x-axis of the left chart starts from 15-Apr-21, not 15-Mar-21.
The labels on the x-axis of the left chart are for every month, not every two months (e.g., 15-Apr-21, 15-May-21, 15-Jun-21).

errors.text_span: От 15-ти юли 2021 г. до 15-ти декември 2021 г. се наблюдава постепенно нарастване до около 80 долара.
errors.evidence: This description is incorrect. In this period, the price fluctuates significantly, dipping from ~75 to ~62 in August, rising to a peak of ~85 in late October, and then falling again to ~73 by mid-December. Describing it as a gradual increase to 80 is a major misrepresentation of the trend.

errors.text_span: След това, до 15-ти януари 2022 г., има лек спад до около 70 долара, след което започва рязко нарастване, достигайки връх над 120 долара около 15-ти февруари 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence describes the trend incorrectly. From mid-December 2021 to mid-January 2022, the price *rises*, not falls. The sharp increase does start, but the peak is in early March (not February) and is well above 120 (closer to 128).

errors.text_span: с етикети на интервали от 16 единици (1, 17, 33, 49, 65, 81, 97, 113, 129, 145, 161, 177, 193, 209, 225, 241, 257 – последната е извън диапазона, така че последният етикет е 241)
errors.evidence: The interval between x-axis ticks on the right chart is 14, not 16. The actual ticks are 1, 15, 29, 43, etc. The list of tick values provided in the description is also incorrect.

errors.text_span: През първите 100 дни цените колебаят между 90 и 110 долара.
errors.evidence: In the right chart, during the first 100 days, the price never drops to 90. The fluctuation is in a narrower range, approximately between 100 and 110.
